sample0.source: four exact packed positive planes expanded independently into valid-padding Conv3x3 256-bit feature tiles

all40_summary.method: strictly re-sum every record into all ten per-sample ledgers and then recompute every summary total and ratio

causal_candidate_window.details: Every new candidate is from the same timestep and feature tile with parent_spatial=spatial-distance, 1<=distance<=min(window,spatial). No future timestep, future tile or future raster position is used. Canonical zero, left, up and same-position previous-timestep candidates are retained with deterministic priority.
causal_candidate_window.boundary_note: At x=0, distance one refers to x=19 of the preceding scanline. This is causal in flattened raster order, but it should be named explicitly rather than being mistaken for a within-row-only window.

finite_bank_metric.definition: maximum popcount of current XOR parent over eight global-feature-index-modulo-8 banks, multiplied by eight 96-lane output blocks
finite_bank_metric.details: The independent raw replay reproduced every sample-0 window cycle count. Combining add and subtract source positions in the same bank capacity is correct when one signed source request occupies one bank issue slot.

signed_conservation.identity: add=(current AND NOT parent), subtract=(parent AND NOT current), disjoint union=current XOR parent
signed_conservation.bounded_arithmetic_limit: No exact weight replay, 19-bit intermediate overflow/order proof, parent-partial SRAM replay or neuron-level accuracy proof is present. Mathematical integer identity must not be relabelled bounded RTL equivalence.

matcher_lower_bound.hidden_parallelism: The one-query-row-per-cycle model requires up to 64 simultaneous 256-bit candidate reads, 64 XOR/bank-popcount comparisons and a reduction, equal to 16384 candidate bits or 2048 bytes per query before current-row traffic.
missing_costs: candidate source-frame SRAM banking, ports and conflicts
selected parent-partial SRAM address, read latency and conflict
matcher comparator and reduction area, timing and energy
startup, drain, backpressure, context and weight-buffer interaction
matcher_lower_bound.interpretation: max(source,matcher) is a valid optimistic lower bound, not a dependency-aware hardware cycle model. Because source dominates every tile, the reported lower bound charges exactly zero visible matcher cycles.

pre_registered_gate.reason: Both gates fail even before charging the online matcher, memory, integrated scheduling, RTL timing, area or energy.

diminishing_return.interpretation: A 64-entry online search substantially increases candidate/memory hardware while improving source work only 1.01x beyond W32 and 1.0447x beyond M53 overall.

admitted: exact identity of the analyzer and its three frozen inputs
all10 source-bank opportunity totals on forty H67 records
sample-0 raw causal candidate, modulo-8 bank and signed-mask recomputation
NO-GO against the preregistered 3x local-zero and 1.5x M53 source-work gates
not_admitted: same-resource RTL or online matcher feasibility
SRAM banking, ports, timing or memory energy
bounded signed arithmetic or accuracy preservation
system speedup, DATE headline or best-paper claim

P1.finding: The best W64 opportunity is only 1.304055x over local-zero and 1.044717x over canonical M53, below the preregistered 3x and 1.5x gates. No sample reaches either gate.
P1.impact: The exact signed online-window mechanism cannot support the required performance headline even under its optimistic source-only lower bound.
P1.minimal_action: Stop window-parent RTL. Preserve M69 as a negative DSE ablation and redirect effort to a mechanism with a materially higher source-work ceiling.

P1.finding: The W64 lower bound assumes one 64-candidate 256-bit query per cycle and perfect overlap; source dominates every tile, so matcher cost disappears entirely. Candidate and parent-partial SRAM ports, conflicts, latency, comparator timing, area and energy are absent.
P1.impact: Any realizable online matcher can only reduce the already failing ratios, while risking a new clock, area and energy bottleneck.
P1.minimal_action: Do not build this matcher RTL. If the branch is retained only as an ablation, add an address-timed banked matcher and parent-partial transaction model before making any cycle statement.

P1.finding: The analyzer emits PASS source-opportunity status and a future RTL next_gate but does not encode or enforce the preregistered 3x/1.5x decision. Signed checks prove mask partition only, not exact bounded 19-bit weighted accumulation or accuracy.
P1.impact: Automation can mistakenly promote a quantitatively failed, numerically unclosed candidate toward RTL.
P1.minimal_action: Add the two exact gate ratios and explicit NO_GO_STOP_WINDOW_RTL status to the contract/result; keep bounded arithmetic, accuracy and integrated cycles false until separately proved.

P2.finding: The producer directory is mode 0775 and contains one mode-0664 JSON, without a preregistration contract, run log, validator receipt, output manifest or completion seal.
P2.minimal_action: Seal an additive NO-GO receipt binding analyzer, inputs, result, exact thresholds and this independent review; do not relabel the dev directory.

P2.finding: Result records aggregate every noncanonical candidate under origin=window and omit the selected distance, parent row/tag and cross-scanline count. Causality is recoverable only by rerunning frozen raw data.
P2.minimal_action: Add per-window selected-distance histograms plus a compact selected-parent identity digest and state explicitly that the window is over flattened raster predecessors.

why: offline assignment removes the 64-way online matcher from the critical path
PAFT can reshape activations toward a compact reusable pattern catalog rather than hoping nearby causal rows already match
pattern IDs and residual masks offer a clearer algorithm-hardware co-design claim than another incremental M53 parent selector
the same frozen bank metric and signed residual ledger can gate the new direction before RTL
minimum_before_rtl: build operator/tile pattern catalogs from training or calibration data only, with validation/test leakage prohibited
run PAFT and seal checkpoint identity plus accuracy delta
replay all10 and Local5 with pattern-ID, residual source work, catalog SRAM bytes/reads and offline assignment cost
require ratio-of-totals local-zero>=3x and M53>=1.5x after catalog/memory costs
only then implement RTL and run Synopsys VCS, Formality, DC/STA and SAIF/PTPX
